title: An approval minted by the issuing path is accepted by the verifying path
proves: The two halves agree. Gates 7 and 8 prove bad approvals are refused and G00b proves a hand-built good one is accepted, but nothing proved the code that MINTS an approval produces one the gateway will take. A mint/verify pair that disagrees fails closed - safe, and completely unusable, with no test telling you why.
